name: Circuit Paul Ricard
layout: 1C-V2 (5.842 km, 15 turns, with Mistral chicane) as used by GT4 European Series (GTWC Endurance weekend) and TCR Europe in 2026

sources.geometry: OpenStreetMap raceway ways (Ligne droite des stands, S de la Verrerie, Virage de l'Hôtel/du Camp/Sainte-Baume, Mistral + Chicane Nord ways 1568166487/229454180, Signes, Beausset, Bendor, Garlaban, Lac, Pont), chained by graph routing; start/finish = OSM node 2255501646 raceway=start-finish. Centre re-aligned to the measured tarmac centre from IGN ortho.
sources.width: Measured from IGN BD ORTHO 20 cm (Géoplateforme WMS-R ORTHOIMAGERY.ORTHOPHOTOS, Lambert-93) as white edge-line pairs every 9 m (found at 371 of 651 cross-sections, median 13.9 m), outliers vs running median rejected, gaps interpolated, smoothed.
sources.elevation: IGN RGE ALTI 1 m via Géoplateforme altimetry API https://data.geopf.fr/altimetrie/1.0/calcul/alti/rest/elevation.json (resource ign_rge_alti_wld)
sources.camber: From RGE ALTI 1 m edge vs centre samples (trackkit.profile_from_samples)
sources.pit: OSM raceway way 799477739 "Stand" (pit lane, modified for the 2019 F1 GP)
sources.trim: Long Mistral straight (1.8 km incl. chicane) but many medium/fast corners: slightly below Spa downforce, lower drag
sources.pitLimit: GT4: 50 km/h (GT4 European Series 2026 stewards decisions/briefings, e.g. https://www.gt4europeanseries.com/documents/notice/3005/ and DEF GT4 BRIEFING SPA 2026); TCR: 60 km/h (2026 TCR Europe Sporting Regulations art. 94, https://europe.tcr-series.com/pdf/2026_TCR_Europe_Sporting_Regs_V3_final.pdf)
sources.layout: GT4 2026 Paul Ricard result PDFs: "Circuit Paul Ricard, Length: 5822m, turn count 15" (https://www.gt4europeanseries.com/results/2026/paul-ricard); TCR Europe 2026 event page: 5,842 m (https://europe.tcr-series.com/index.php/2026-ev/item/le-castellet)

notes: Both series use the 15-turn layout with the Mistral chicane (1C-V2). SRO timing sheets quote 5,822 m, TCR Europe/circuit 5,842 m; official set to 5,842. Turn numbering follows the F1 2018-19 map. pitLoss unknown for GT4/TCR (omitted).
